cd /app/tmp && timeout 100 python3 -c "
import subprocess, time
cases = {
 'quotes': ('\"'*16000000),
 'longstr': ('\"'+'a'*33000000),
 'brackets': ('['*2000000 + ']'*2000000),
 'commas': ('[1,'*8000000 + '1]'),
 'nested_mix': ('[{\"a\":'*100000 + '1' + '}]'*100000),
}
lines=[]
for k,v in cases.items():
    lines.append(v[:33000000])
data='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
print('input MB %.1f' % (len(data)/1e6))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=250)
print('%.2fs rc=%d lines=%d' % (time.time()-t, p.returncode, len(p.stdout.count(chr(10)))))
print(p.stdout[:200].replace(chr(10),'|'))
"
